name: Soft-Scrambled Large Eggs (Cooked in Butter or Olive Oil)
whyItWorks: Egg protein (ovalbumin) has the highest biological value of any whole food (BV = 100). Soft curds require zero chewing energy, contain 0g fiber, are naturally lactose-free, and provide essential amino acids to rebuild damaged intestinal mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 2 eggs with a splash of water and salt. Cook over low heat in a nonstick skillet with a dab of butter until soft, creamy curds form. Do not overcook or brown.
watchOuts: One of the most restorative, easily digested whole protein sources for IBD.
